editor.premise: A countryside berry harvest becomes a kitchen session of sorting, cooking, and preserving, with practical instructions woven into quiet daily observations.

chapters.name: Berry harvest
chapters.purpose: Establish the harvest and introduce what the fruit will become.

chapters.name: Sorting and storage
chapters.purpose: Bring the harvest indoors and demonstrate fresh storage.

chapters.name: Making jam
chapters.purpose: Follow preparation and cooking through two different batches.

chapters.name: Filling and preserving
chapters.purpose: Turn cooked fruit into filled, sealed, heat-treated jars.

captions.note: Small bottom-centered diary and instructional sentences persist across several cuts; a central opening title and occasional playful annotations break the pattern.

editor.notes: Alternate people working with tactile inserts. Keep captions running across cuts so reading survives the brisk montage. Skip repeated handling with jump cuts, but lengthen pours and mixing. Use a landscape insert to suggest waiting without showing the wait.
